intro: Draw shapes, change colours and instantly see what your picture looks like as SVG source code.

hero.badge: DRAW • SEE THE CODE • LEARN SVG •

live.title: Draw and instantly see the source code
live.text: Every shape you draw is a line of SVG. Flex Draw shows both at once – change the picture and the code changes, change the code and the picture changes.
live.point1: Each shape = one line of code
live.point3: Edit the code, see the picture

demo.label: Animated example of Flex Draw
demo.caption: Animation: a smiley is drawn shape by shape. Next to it, the matching SVG source code is typed line by line.
demo.svgLabel: Smiley with a box, a star and a squiggle, built from SVG shapes

combine.title: Combine shapes
combine.text: Two shapes, four ways to merge them into a new one. Perfect for moons, keyholes and doughnuts.

unite.name: Unite
unite.alt: Square and circle united into one shape

intersect.name: Intersect
intersect.alt: Only the overlap of square and circle remains

subtract.name: Subtract
subtract.text: The top shape bites a piece out.
subtract.alt: The circle cuts a piece out of the square

exclude.name: Exclude
exclude.alt: Square and circle without their overlap

files.title: Your picture as SVG – open and save
files.text: No secret format: your drawing is a real .svg file. It opens in every browser and in lots of other programs.

open.title: Open
open.text: Load an SVG file and keep drawing.

edit.title: Change
edit.text: Move shapes, pick colours, edit the code.

privacy.title: No account. No tracking. Runs in the browser.
privacy.text: Children just start drawing. Nothing to sign up for, nothing that gets sent away.

account.title: No account
account.text: No login, no email, no password.

server.title: No server
server.text: Your drawing stays on your device.

tracking.title: No tracking
tracking.text: No cookies, no analytics, no ads.

offline.title: Almost offline
offline.text: Once loaded, it keeps working without the internet.

open.title: Open source
open.text: All the code is public on GitHub.

school.title: Built for the classroom
school.text: Made for computer science lessons with children: small, clear and calm enough for a whole class.

kids.title: For children
kids.text: Big buttons, few tools, a friendly design.

langs.title: German and English
langs.text: Switch the language with one click.

touch.title: Tablets too
touch.text: Works with mouse, pen and finger.

help.title: Help with pictures
help.text: A help page that explains every tool.

cta.title: Ready? Draw your first SVG.
cta.text: It opens straight away – no install, no account.

footer.about: A small SVG editor for computer science lessons.
footer.license: Open source under the MIT licence
footer.made: Made for curious kids and their teachers.
